metadata.description:
You’ve found it—one of Minneapolis’s most sacred pop culture relics, quietly nestled in a nondescript neighborhood. This unassuming house played a starring role in Purple Rain, anchoring the story of The Kid and echoing with the spirit of Prince. It’s not marked with neon or crowds, but fans know the feeling when they’re close. This Easter Egg POAP is your symbol of devotion, mystery, and the magic that still lingers in the purple shadow of greatness. 

Category: Easter Egg 
GPS: 44.94065, -93.23062 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.94065,-93.23062 
Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Purple_Rain_(film)
